title: Bank Account KYC Blocked with Shortened Bitly Link
text: Dear customer, your SBI account KYC is suspended. Your netbanking will be deactivated within 12 hours. Update your pan card immediately to unblock your account: click https://bit.ly/sbi-pan-kyc-verify
description: Bank KYC phishing lure sent from a 10-digit number with a shortened URL and suspension threat.
